title: Seabed Mining Claims Climbed To 31
hook: Seabed mining now has 31 exploration contracts.
closing: The resource race is growing while more countries question whether digging should begin.
question: Should seabed mining move forward?

segments.say: There are 31 exploration contracts now. The race for the ocean floor is expanding.
Seabed nodules hold 44 million tonnes of cobalt, making the ocean floor the larger measured prize.
The pause-or-ban camp reached 37 countries, showing resistance is growing with the race.
